title: Uridium
build: Hewson's disk release, a GCR image of the protected original (disk name gma240286); booted through a copy with track 39's sync marks restored (orientation.md)

credits.role: Design and programming, as the title page credits it
Music, as the manual credits it

tools.host: Linux x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04, no display (cloud container)
tools.browser: Chromium from Playwright 1.56.1 (headless), for the page check

exclude: not the game's: the loader's loading screen ("GMA86", "URIDIUM", "BY ANDREW BRAYBROOK", "PUBLISHED BY HEWSON CONSULTANTS LTD"), left in the default screen; the game shows video bank 1 only
runtime: the random byte table, a copy of the sound driver's 256 bytes at $1000 made by game_start and stirred with noise by stir_random
runtime: the screen and the sprite pointers, drawn by the code (draw_map, print_string); the loaded screen here is the fuel rod chamber, which game_start copies to $A600 before the code ever reads it
runtime: the shadow shapes $70-$9F, built from the Manta's frames at $5000 by thicken_shapes at every restart; the loaded bytes here are the Dreadnought tile sets, which game_start has moved to $D400
runtime: the playfield characters $80-$FF, copied in for each level from a tile set at $D400, $D800 or $DC00 (copy_tile_set), or from $D200 for the chamber
runtime and leftover: the load's copy of $E000-$E1FF, left behind by game_start, with the reset vectors restart writes at $8000 and the giant message's piece list build_message writes from $8010
runtime: the Dreadnought map, 17 rows of 512 columns, built at every level start by build_map
leftover: the load's copy of $CE00-$CFFF (level 15's map list), moved there by game_start; the code reads that copy
not loaded: the RAM fill pattern above the end of the file
unused: zeros after the enemy paths, inside the block game_start copies to $C000
unused: the RAM fill pattern under the I/O chips, below the chamber's characters
unused: zeros after the level names
unused: the RAM fill pattern at the top of the last level list's page, below the hardware vectors
include: the chamber's characters and the three Dreadnought tile sets, kept under the I/O chips

regions: zero page: the sprite work copy, pointers, the Manta, the wave, the sound driver's state
generator port lists and both players' saved state
start-up, title, play loop, Manta, waves and enemies, map builder, bonus chamber, sound driver
star masks, status colours, manoeuvres, sprite records, colour schemes, gun and collision tables, wave types, scores, chamber tables
the giant message, title page, icons and the hall of fame
launch, game over, bonus and initials strings
voice set-ups, 46 effects and instruments, note tables, the song and its patterns
sprite shapes: transporter, bullets, mines, explosions
the sixteen fighters and their mirror images
library: stick, keys, sprites, printing, copying, volume
screen row addresses and the volume string
giant letters, wave lists, wave records and fighter paths
the chamber's characters and the three Dreadnought tile sets
per-level tables and the first level names
